approvals.mutation: harden and execute the container-smoke workflow
approvals.trustedRefsAndEvents: master push and workflow_dispatch only; never pull_request

approvals.mutation: create a separate backup cadence task and perform an isolated restore drill
approvals.independenceClass: same-volume exception explicitly accepted by owner; not independent from the live C: store
approvals.taskAction: not approved until the backup-cadence script and exact invocation are reviewed
approvals.taskTrigger: not approved until the cadence schedule is explicitly selected
requiredBeforeMutation: administrative verification that C: encryption is enabled
target root must already exist and pass non-mutating ACL verification
exact task identity, action, trigger, and principal validation
constraints: no replacement of an existing Scheduled Task
never restore over the live store
no production access, release, cutover, or flip

approvals.mutation: reconcile historical S08 and S09 plan evidence
constraints: S10 CLOSED_GO is evidence for S10 only
do not claim the S08-S10 umbrella plan is complete without distinct S08/S09 evidence
